pr_title: fix: update javascript mime type to text/javascript
pr_body:
<!-- Thank you for contributing! -->

### Description

This PR updates `sirv` and `mrmime`, which updates the javascript mime type to `text/javascript` (from `application/javascript`). I figured to update it everywhere in our codebase too for consistency.

Note that the HTML spec [recommends using `text/javascript` instead](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/scripting.html#scriptingLanguages). `application/javascript` is deprecated.

Additionally mrmime v2: https://github.com/lukeed/mrmime/releases/tag/v2.0.0

- close https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/15398
- close https://github.com/vitejs/vite/pull/15420
- blocks https://github.com/vitejs/vite/pull/15375

### Additional context

Needs to run ecosystem in case there's significant breakage to the changed mime type for js and mjs files.

---
